sdk_source_refs: OCC surrogate: tolerance growth around generated topology
test_goal: Exercise a thickened rectangular sheet through boolean subtraction and side-contact tolerance clusters.
risk_summary: Thicken/offset can create side and cap topology whose tolerances differ from the input sheet; downstream boolean can expose invalid topology or bad volume relation.

geometry.parameter_notes: Use asymmetric min/max distances and keep thickness comfortably above topo_tol for regression candidates.

expected_behavior: The thickened target should cut cleanly, remain non-empty, and keep exact x/z extrema within tolerance.
notes: Seed from boolean_thicken_rect_sheet_smoke.json when reviewing model output.
